Option O1 references missing risk Linear accumulation of artifacts can pressure context-window bounds if context-pack selection is not strict.

Option O3 references missing risk Budget thresholds for partial-freeze decisions can be misestimated, freezing too early/late.

Option O4 references missing risk Monolith becomes a high-blast-radius component for failures and changes.
Decision reference missing: Parallelize only lane-executable work; reserve all cross-lane coupling resolution to a single deterministic Integration stage to reduce nondeterminism at fan-in.
Decision reference missing: Use namespaced workspace partitions per lane plus a canonical integration partition to contain side effects and simplify traceability and context-pack bounding.
Decision reference missing: Define deterministic merge/apply ordering rules that are independent of wall-clock completion timing to preserve reproducibility.
Decision reference missing: Enforce two-level gating: lane-scoped validators must pass before integration, and integrated full-repo validators must pass before Judge→Freeze.
Decision reference missing: Keep reviewers strictly findings-only across both lane and integration reviews; all writing/patching remains with writer/patcher roles under orchestrator control.

Decision reference missing: Treat integration conflicts and cross-lane regressions as first-class artifacts (conflict/integration reports) that drive deterministic escalation (patch → reroute → HITL → ChangeRequest).
